annotation.title_clean: Directive 97/68/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 December 1997 on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Directive 97/68/EC on measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 059
annotation.summary_en: EU Directive 97/68/EC sets staged emission limits and type-approval procedures for compression-ignition engines installed in non-road mobile machinery such as construction equipment. It covers conformity of production, engine markings, and mutual recognition among Member States. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Two-stage emission limits for CO, HC, NOx and particulates for engines of 18-560 kW
EU type-approval of engine types and families by Member State authorities
Conformity-of-production arrangements and engine marking requirements
Member States may not refuse placing on the market of compliant engines
Commission committee procedure for adapting annexes to technical progress
